(branch `main`; MIT LICENSE at root, © 2022 NiuTrans Open Source),
retrieved **2026-08-29** via raw.githubusercontent.com — one per censused

- `双语数据/世说新语/仇隙/` — a book/chapter unit: 39 line-aligned
  sentence pairs (source.txt lzh · target.txt cmn · bitext.txt the

- `双语数据/三十六计/并战计/上屋抽梯/` — a book/SECTION/chapter unit

All eight files are byte-verbatim complete downloads — never trimmed or
hand-edited.

Census facts the tests pin: 97 books / 7,304 chapter units, every unit a
perfectly symmetric {source,target,bitext,数据来源} quartet (0 orphans);
source/target line-aligned (equal counts ARE the format); BOTH sides
simplified script; UTF-8 NFC-stable. The fork nk2028/Classical-Modern
(frozen 2022-02-08, chapters concatenated into 27 per-book blobs) is
recorded so nobody re-scouts it — the canonical upstream is NiuTrans.
